# Backup and device transfer libraries

- fflate 0.8.2 — Arjun Barrett — MIT. `fflate-LICENSE.txt`; https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
- qrcode-generator 1.4.4 — Kazuhiko Arase — MIT. `qrcode-LICENSE.txt`; https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- jsQR 1.4.0 — Cozmo — Apache-2.0. `jsQR-LICENSE.txt`; https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

These files are bundled locally. Opening backup or device-transfer tools does not load a QR/compression library from a third-party CDN.
